name: Anastasius the Lisper
bio: Anastasius the Lisper is known to the Greek Anthology as the author of a short religious epigram on Christ crucified, one of the Byzantine pieces added in the fifteenth book.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XV: 28.

poems.title: Book XV, 28: On Christ Crucified
poems.author: Anastasius the Lisper
poems.text: Christ once was nailed naked on the cross, in the midst, with robbers crucified on either side. And His Mother, grieving sore, bewailed Him loudly, standing by and sobbing, and another, His virgin companion. And the wayfarers mocked and reviled Him in His misery, calling Him a man of no account or courage. And the wicked and bloodthirsty people of the Jews offered Him, when He thirsted, an abominable drink, filling a bitter cup with vinegar, the potion of death. But Christ, outstretched there, was silent and resisted not, Christ, the Son of Mary and an immortal Father. A proud man shall be as an infant when he reflects on this in his heart and sees it in pictures; for God is better than men, but man in no way better than God.
